independence: Reviewer authored the measurement harness, not the production codec, selection, client or endpoint changes. This review excludes that harness and the workflow.
source_scope: Exact working-tree hashes below, after the recorded procedural PASS and before the implementation commit
procedural_gate: PASS in .agent-sync/AUDIT.md and premeasurement-review.json, read before this review
reviewed_invariants: Mode9 is explicit, limited to 16 MiB, and rejects both manifest and base identifiers. Existing generic senders/CLI do not silently activate it.

Whole decoding validates compressed-size bounds, one exact zstd frame, required checksum, forbidden dictionary/reserved flags, exact declared output length and the 32 MiB window ceiling before output allocation. Decompression checksum and written length are checked. Session-only reset permits recovery after a malformed frame without importing a previous target as a dictionary.

Buffered Data retains canonical mode/length/flag checks, bounded chunk count and cumulative compressed capacity. Begin reserves encoded input, output and decoder allowance under the existing shared budget before acceptance.

Whole and schema prepared decoders use the existing opt-in cache with eight entries, 5 MiB admission charge, pinned handles and pressure fallback. Whole's no-artifact sentinel is separated by namespace and mode; it is not an authorization token.

Endpoint authorization still runs before handling and before publication. Schema Begin still locates and verifies the authorized artifact before cached codec reuse. Caller-supplied schema_ready changes cost estimation only; absent or unauthorized state still fails at the receiver.

Finish checks exact reconstructed length and whole-object digest before the unchanged private staging, file synchronization, authorization recheck, atomic rename and directory synchronization. Published is returned only after publication succeeds; corrupted frames do not expose a committed object.

PreparedTransfer's offer/payload are private outside the crate and the consuming client cannot receive replacement target bytes. Preparation binds the original object once; the receipt is read-only and cannot mutate the selected transfer. Checked cost totals and strict comparisons preserve Raw/Whole/Schema tie order.

Selection computes all eligible candidates and charges a separate successful Raw seed when cold. It does not automatically seed or treat readiness as permission. The caller must complete an explicit seed before consuming a schema plan. Encoded and Raw payload paths reject repair requests rather than reoffer or silently retry; transport and missing-state errors propagate.
No cryptographic implementation, dependency, authentication mechanism or existing on-disk publication format changed. Existing adaptive selection remains separate from the new explicit API.
